profile.description: Fictional wholly owned U.S. office and distribution group selling finished non-energy-consuming office supplies.
profile.rationale: Synthetic ownership roster states full ownership and operational control throughout 2025.

evidence.title: Synthetic 2025 corporate roster
evidence.excerpt: Juniper parent controls its wholly owned California and Nevada distribution subsidiaries throughout 2025; all three entities operate one listed facility.

evidence.title: Synthetic California annual electricity worksheet
evidence.excerpt: Twelve manually entered months are recorded for the California warehouse. Only January has a synthetic bill. Eleven bill months remain missing. No method is released.

evidence.title: Synthetic Nevada utility statement — wrong year
evidence.excerpt: Utility service dates cover calendar 2024. The preparer's row asserts calendar 2025. This attachment cannot resolve the period conflict.

evidence.title: Synthetic Nevada district-heat contract
evidence.excerpt: Nevada warehouse purchases heat during 2025. Metered quantities, supplier information and a reviewed applicable calculation method remain unavailable.

evidence.title: Synthetic procurement screening memo
evidence.excerpt: Procurement proposes spend-based screening for purchased goods and services, pending supplier/activity refinement, factor review, category allocation and uncertainty assessment. No emission value has been calculated.

evidence.title: Synthetic business-model screening memo
evidence.excerpt: Management states the group sells finished non-energy-consuming office supplies, has no franchises, does not lease assets to customers and has no separate investment portfolio. These statements support proposed screening decisions only and await review across the full entity register.

evidence.title: Synthetic commute survey proposal
evidence.excerpt: HR proposes a commute survey with a documented response rate, extrapolation and remote-work assumptions. Collection and method approval remain pending.

evidence.title: Synthetic challenge: Canadian subsidiary discovered
evidence.excerpt: A newly found roster addendum identifies a wholly owned and operationally controlled Canadian subsidiary and warehouse operating throughout 2025. It was omitted from the initial supplied roster.
